description:
Schedule, manage and analyze Fediverse accounts on any FediSuite instance FediSuite is an open platform for the Fediverse: plan posts in a calendar, collect drafts, automatically split long posts into threads, see reach and engagement, and manage multiple accounts across 20+ platforms, including Mastodon, Pixelfed, PeerTube, Misskey, Friendica, WordPress (via the ActivityPub plugin) and BizzFed. The whole stack is open source under the GPL-3.0, with no Google Play and no tracking. Official website: https://www.fedisuite.com To use this app you first need an account on a FediSuite instance. A list of public instances that accept new registrations is available at https://www.fedisuite.com/instances. You can also run your own instance, the server source code is freely available too. Reach, the calendar and drafts need an instance running FediSuite 2.0 or newer. The Android app This is a real native Android client, not a WebView wrapper and not a shrunk-down desktop clone. It connects to the FediSuite instance you choose and brings the most important workflows to your phone:
  • Keep an eye on multiple Fediverse accounts from one dashboard, with compact analytics on follower growth, engagement, best posting times and tips
  • See reach per account: net and gross estimates, trend, top posts and a short explanation of how the estimate is made
  • Write posts, attach media and alt text, and publish right away, plan with a date and time picker, or save as a draft
  • Where the platform supports it: send a post as plain text, Markdown or HTML; hashtags, mentions and links are colored while you write
  • Reopen and finish drafts later, including drafts you started on the web
  • Calendar for a month or a week with filters for status and account; move, publish now, send again, take back to drafts, copy or delete posts right there
  • Browse your posts by status, follow the delivery status after publishing and send failed posts again
  • View and disconnect connected accounts
  • Use the admin area if your account has the right permissions on that instance
  • Sign in securely, also with a two-factor code; signing out ends the session on the server as well
  • Available in German, English, French, Spanish and Italian
Built for touchscreens: large tap targets, cards instead of tables, dark and light theme. No Google Play required, no tracking, no ads. License: GPL-3.0.
